name: Decline Close-Grip Bench Press
description: A compound triceps exercise combining the decline bench angle with a close grip. The decline reduces shoulder involvement and increases triceps work, while the close grip further isolates the triceps. This is an excellent mass builder for the entire triceps.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Decline Close-Grip Bench Press in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Decline Close-Grip Bench Press.
steps: Step 1: Set bench to decline. Secure legs. Grip bar shoulder-width or slightly inside.
Step 2: Unrack bar and lower to lower chest with elbows tucked.
Step 3: Keep elbows close to body throughout descent.
Step 4: Press bar back to lockout contracting triceps.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Gripping too narrow causing wrist strain
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
